verdict.rationale: Canny's Autopilot is documented as automatically capturing feedback from sales, support, and chat sources. Named integrations include Gong, Fathom, and Fireflies call transcripts, Intercom, and Slack, which covers all three channels in the story. All of this comes from vendor marketing and integration-directory text, with no detail on how extraction works. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, in-depth docs on extraction accuracy and deduplication, and explicitly named support-ticketing systems beyond generic 'support' platforms.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically capture customer feedback mentioned in sales calls, support tickets, and chat conversations
